title: Preparation of Graphite Intercalation Compound of Vanadium Fluoride in Fluorine Atmosphere
abstract: Abstract                Graphite intercalation compound(GIC) of vanadium fluoride has been prepared in fluorine atmosphere. The GIC’s prepared were stage 1–8 compounds with composition, C8.4−79.5VF5.8−6.0. The size of intercalated VF6−(di) decreased from 0.533 nm to 0.415 nm with increasing x in CxVF6. The compounds with small di’s showed high stability in air.
